description.value: Tim's Fish & Chips is a takeout-only fish and chip shop located on Northwest Boulevard in Creston, BC. For touring cyclists passing through the Creston Valley, it offers a classic fast-food stop in a town that sits at the junction of several regional cycling routes. The takeout-only format makes it a practical grab-and-go option rather than a sit-down rest.
